Unte uma forma de furo no meio de 20 cm de diâmetro e despeje a massa, leve pra assar em forno pré aquecido à 180 graus por 45-50 minutos, espere esfriar e desenforme!  Cobertura:  1 lata de leite condensado gelado  1 caixinha de creme de leite gelado  400 gramas de nata  1 colher de sopa de manteiga sem sal em ponto pomada  1 xícara de leite em pó  Bata tudo muito bem até chegar em um ponto bem cremoso, aproximadamente 5 minutos! Chocolate Molten Lava Cake Ingredients: 4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted 3 oz semisweet chocolate, chopped 1 egg 1 egg yolk 2 tbsp granulated sugar Pinch of salt 1 tbsp flour (I used gluten-free) Directions: Preheat the oven to 450 F In a heat-proof bowl, melt the chocolate and butter over a double boiler, then cool for 5 minutes In a separate bowl, use an electric mixer to mix the egg, egg yolk, sugar, salt, and flour together until it is pale yellow and foamy Add the egg mixture to the chocolate mixture and mix until just combined Bake for 7-8 minutes, until the sides and top are set and the center is jiggly Let cool for 1-2 minutes, then serve upside down on a plate with toppings of choice Enjoy!! #lavacake #chocolatelavacake #trendingfoods #viralrecipes
